entities.name: Anna
entities.description: Guard of Kara Yazgı who was killed by Khalid when she failed to bring the sword.
entities.quote: in khalids stroy,she dies by the hands of khalid.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: Killer of Anna who was later defeated and killed by Ravenblade using Kara Yazgı.
entities.quote: Ravenblade kills Khalid using Kara Yazgı

entities.name: Aeric Valenheart
entities.description: An ancient being trapped in a pocket dimension who originally forged Kara Yazgı.
entities.quote: The sword was originally made by Aeric Valenheart

entities.name: Ravenblade
entities.description: Warrior who survives the psychological demands of Kara Yazgı and kills Khalid.
entities.quote: Ravenblade uses Kara Yazgı to kill Khalid

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: Character described as too reactive to hold Kara Yazgı.

entities.name: Vanguard
entities.description: Character described as too procedural to wield Kara Yazgı.

entities.name: Yoshiko
entities.description: Character described as too strategic to wield Kara Yazgı.

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Character described as too chaotic to wield Kara Yazgı.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: Character described as too burdened by ideology to wield Kara Yazgı.

timeline_events.title: Forging of Kara Yazgı
timeline_events.description: Aeric Valenheart creates the legendary sword Kara Yazgı as a failsafe weapon that exposes the truth of its wielder.
timeline_events.quote: The sword was originally made by Aeric Valenheart

timeline_events.title: Death of Anna
timeline_events.description: Anna misjudges Khalid and is killed by him before her summoned sword Kara Yazgı can reach her.
timeline_events.quote: Khalid kills Anna without Kara Yazgı

timeline_events.title: Death of Khalid
timeline_events.description: Ravenblade uses Kara Yazgı to kill Khalid, turning his own fear against him.
timeline_events.quote: Ravenblade kills Khalid using Kara Yazgı
